workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots where they are both free for the partners' meeting:

Mon Nov 16: 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM
Tue Nov 17: 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM, 4:30 PM
Wed Nov 18: 3:00 PM, 3:30 PM
Thu Nov 19: 10:00 AM
Fri Nov 20: 11:00 AM, 11:30 AM

Could you please check these times against Elena's and David's calendars and let me know which of these work for them? Thanks.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
